g.text: Equipment nameplate template · 4 × 2 in (101.6 × 50.8 mm) · 2-ply engraving
laminate, Night Navy cap / white core · 3.2 mm holes at 4.2 mm from edges
UL 508A / NEC 409.110 marking: manufacturer, supply voltage, phase,
frequency, full-load current, largest motor FLA, SCCR, enclosure type,
Brand: lockup-white 6.6 mm mark; labels Plex Mono Medium 1.55 mm caps;
values Plex Mono SemiBold 2.15 mm (min. 1.5 mm cap height engraved).
